description: Scala source code for SizeEstimator object in Apache Spark, providing memory size estimation for Java objects on the JVM heap.

classes.name: SizeEstimator.SearchState
classes.description: Represents the state during size estimation, including visited objects, a stack of objects to process, and total size.

classes.name: SizeEstimator.ClassInfo
classes.description: Caches class layout information such as shell size and pointer fields.

methods.name: estimate
methods.description: Estimates the size of an object in bytes, including referenced objects.

methods.name: visitSingleObject
methods.description: Visits a single object to accumulate its size, handling arrays, reflection, and class hierarchy.

methods.name: visitArray
methods.description: Estimates size of array objects, sampling large arrays for efficiency.

methods.name: sampleArray
methods.description: Samples elements of large arrays to estimate total size.

methods.name: primitiveSize
methods.description: Returns the size in bytes of primitive data types.

methods.name: getClassInfo
methods.description: Retrieves or computes cached class layout information.

methods.name: alignSizeUp
methods.description: Calculates size aligned to a specified boundary, typically for object layout.
